metadata.name: Expanded Foods: Chef's Tricks
metadata.description: Non-cooking things you can do with chef's tools that you may not expect.

playerImpact.text: Adds crumb feed, fresh resin, salt crystals, washed eggshells and oil/lard utility recipes.

vanillaDelta.text: Adds processing and substitutions; it is not a new cooking station.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified in the complete config inventory. Native recipe assets are the audited baseline.

crossModInteractions.text: Metadata requires expandedfoods >=2.0.0-dev.12; native guide also names ACA. Recipe assets include oil-powered mechanical components and conditional superfuel recipes.

practicalHowTo.text: Seal 8 eggshells with 1 L water to wash them; use the washed output for lime. Salt-water/brine crystals are another branch; consult the actual barrel recipe and salt-crystal processing attributes rather than inventing a quern recipe file.

playerImpact.text: Native recipes add au gratin, compote, hot pasta and pilaf; mixing recipes add cold pasta, salad and yogurt meals.

vanillaDelta.text: Extends existing meals and ingredient categories; do not attribute dumpling/sushi recipes from other modules to this installed module.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified; patch dependencies determine conditional compatibility.

crossModInteractions.text: Metadata requires expandedfoods >=2.0.0-dev.10. The native guide describes ACA liquid eggs and EF broth/oil toppings.

practicalHowTo.text: Choose a native cooking or mixing recipe first. Hot pasta uses the cooking-pot route; cold pasta uses mixing. Native guide says soup can use broth or vegetable juice rather than water, and liquid egg replaces shell eggs in its scrambled-egg recipe.

playerImpact.text: Makes ignition tool-dependent; guide covers handdrill, bowdrill, flint-and-steel, quartz, spyglass and torch conditions.

vanillaDelta.text: Changes the reliability of existing ignition methods; meaningful first-fire impact, not just decorative tools.

configStatus.text: All eight Firestarter config files are present. Vanilla firestarter: temperature/rain/wind checks, minimum 10°C. Bowdrill and torch: checks enabled, minimum 5°C. Quartz: minimum 10°C, hours 9-15, rain/wind/cloud checks. Spyglass: minimum 7°C, hours 8-16, rain/wind/cloud checks. Flint-and-steel: rain/wind checks and enabled 10% break chance. Miscellaneous: both wind and backpack torch extinction enabled.

crossModInteractions.text: Manual Firestarter separately changes the vanilla tinder route. Both providers are enabled; their final combined handler precedence is not verified live.

practicalHowTo.text: Read the native environmental guide and tool warning; change conditions or tool when refused rather than assuming every tool shares the same weather limits.

metadata.name: FoodShelves
metadata.description: Contains various food shelves and food storage, mainly made to be used alongside Expanded Foods.

playerImpact.text: Adds categorized shelves, baskets and preservation furniture, including ice-cooled cabinets and non-melting ice reserve storage.

vanillaDelta.text: Not all containers refrigerate or accept all foods.

configStatus.text: GlobalBlockBuffs=true, LakeIceToCutIce=false, GlobalPerishMultiplier=1, CooledBuff=.3, IceMeltRate=1. In particular, do not instruct players to convert lake ice directly: that option is disabled. Client configuration only changes presentation.

crossModInteractions.text: Native guide explicitly requires EF for barrel-rack liquid curing; baskets inside cabinets inherit cabinet preservation.

practicalHowTo.text: Keep cabinet and ice drawer closed, replace melting Cut Ice, and put spare ice in an Ice Keeper. Use each block’s accepted-content handbook entry.

playerImpact.text: Adds aimed-at-water washing for held meal and cooked-container blocks.

vanillaDelta.text: Vanilla already supports emptying dishes by tossing them into water; this adds an explicit held interaction, not a hygiene debuff or mandatory clean-dish gate.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config or bundled configuration asset identified. Mouse handler registers a 1000ms hold callback.

crossModInteractions.text: Works with base BlockMeal / BlockCookedContainerBase and their empty-container attributes; support for every custom vessel is not established.

practicalHowTo.text: Aim at water holding the meal bowl/cooked container and hold right-click about one second. It empties the dish, discarding edible contents; finish the meal first.

metadata.name: Manual Dough
metadata.description: Make dough in a more immersive way

coverage.classification: manual kneading and targeted grid-recipe removal

playerImpact.text: Converts held flour into matching grain dough with water.

vanillaDelta.text: StartServerSide reads DisableDoughRecipes and calls RemoveDoughRecipes; the configured route replacement is backed by IL, not just a setting name.

configStatus.text: HoldDuration=1000ms, CooldownDuration=1000ms, DisableDoughRecipes=true. These are the exact serialized settings; no FlourToDoughRatio or LitersOfWaterPerDough setting is present.

crossModInteractions.text: The water path derives the dough code from the held flour in the same asset domain. Blood conversion explicitly looks up butchering:blooddough-<grain>; ordinary water dough does not require blood.

practicalHowTo.text: Hold spelt flour, aim at water and hold right-click about one second for spelt dough. Hotbar water-container supply is another supported route.

metadata.name: Manual Firestarter
metadata.description: This replaces the automatic ignition of the Vanilla Firestarter with a manual approach.

playerImpact.text: Requires ground tinder, sneaking alternating clicks and carrying glowing tinder to the built firepit.

vanillaDelta.text: Stock starter-guide direct ignition wording needs this modpack qualification.

configStatus.text: AccessibilityEnabled=false; TargetValue=100; GainPerValidClick=2; DecayTickIntervalMs=100; DecayPerTick=5. The accessibility override exists in LoadOrCreate but is NOT active in this exported pack configuration.

crossModInteractions.text: Tutorial addon manualfirestartertutorial 1.2.1 supplies exact controls and adapts to enabled Art of Growing straw. Firestarters is also enabled; final handler precedence is not live-tested.

practicalHowTo.text: Build the pit, place separate tinder nearby, sneak-right-click that tinder with the firestarter, keep still and alternate clicks. Carry hot tinder to the completed pit and right-click.

metadata.name: Rustic Cookery
metadata.description: Enjoy hearty pot roasts and braised dishes alongside a new meat slab texture compatible with most creature mods.

playerImpact.text: Adds roasting dishes/lids/tongs, sliced ingredients, meat slabs and smoking furniture.

vanillaDelta.text: Adds fat-rendering/searing/softening/liquid stages beyond ordinary cooking-pot slots.

configStatus.text: ConfigVersion=5; SlabSize=6; AutoSlabs and ExtraSlabs=true; SmokingSeconds=2880; PotRoastBakeSeconds=240; BraiseFatSeconds=20, Brown=30, Soften=30, Reduce=120, Roux=30; FullSmokeAmount=64; UncoveredDishPerishMul=1.5. These are exported base settings, not a live-world timing guarantee.

crossModInteractions.text: Native pot-roast directions explicitly accept rendered fat/lard/cooking oil and EF broth, and name the clay oven for finishing. Exported SlabRules include Butchering and animal-mod entity patterns; each remains conditional on matching entities.

practicalHowTo.text: Fire a clay-formed roasting dish, set it on a lit firepit and hold tongs offhand. Render fat, sear a whole meat slab, soften sides, add liquid, then finish the removed pot roast in a preheated clay oven and serve with bowls.

playerImpact.text: Prepared firewood cures into seasoned fuel; runtime also edits raw/aged firewood and pit-kiln fuel.

vanillaDelta.text: Raw wood remains allowed for first-fire construction and clay ovens in this export. Shipped seasoned-to-aged transition is disabled by pack configuration.

configStatus.text: PreparedFirewoodCuringHours=96; SeasonedFirewoodBurnTemperature=500 and BurnDuration=160; RawFirewoodBurnTemperature=700 and BurnDuration=24; AgedFirewoodBurnTemperature=700 and BurnDuration=160. RawFirewoodCanStartFirepit=true and RawFirewoodCanBeOvenFuel=true; EnableSeasonedToAgedTransition=false. Runtime IL applies settings and removes the disabled Cure transition.

crossModInteractions.text: Mod ID tseasonedfirewood uses asset namespace fseasonedfirewood. Runtime normalizes aged transition target to game:agedfirewood, not an invented mod ID namespace.

practicalHowTo.text: Shapelessly combine a knife and 2 firewood for 2 prepared firewood; let it cure. Alternatively surround resin, beeswax or rendered fat with 8 firewood to craft 8 seasoned firewood directly. The next seasoned-to-aged transition is disabled.

metadata.name: Simple Tea
metadata.description: Adds tea that can be cooked in a pot

playerImpact.text: Floral, wild, medicinal and toxic teas have hot/cold variants. Toxic tea harms health; medicinal tea has health effects.

vanillaDelta.text: Uses cooking-pot recipes, not an invented kettle station. Hot tea cools, cold tea eventually turns back into water.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified; use the bundled recipe and liquid transition assets.

crossModInteractions.text: The asset supplies hydrationByType, but these declarations alone do not establish an active thirst provider. Standard nutritionPropsPerLitre defines floral/wild satiety and medicinal/toxic health. Do not add an undocumented Useful Stuff buff dependency.

practicalHowTo.text: Cook 1 L water plus one cornflower for floral tea. Do not substitute toxic flowers; open medicinal tea ingredients before brewing a healing drink.

metadata.name: Stick Roast
metadata.description: Let's you use a stick to roast food

playerImpact.text: Patches ordinary sticks with StickRoasting behavior and creates a roastingstick carrying food.

vanillaDelta.text: Adds main/offhand roasting at a burning firepit instead of a new pot-meal category or grid-crafted skewer.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified; cooking properties are read from roastable food.

crossModInteractions.text: IsRoastable checks eligibility dynamically. Shipped patches adjust raw redmeat/poultry/bushmeat/fish storage flags; compatibility with every modded food is not established.

practicalHowTo.text: Hold stick main-hand and roastable food offhand, right-click to skewer, then hold right-click at a burning firepit. Empty offhand and Ctrl-right-click to remove food.

metadata.name: Stone Bake Oven
metadata.description: Creates a usable large stone oven for baking and more.

playerImpact.text: Adds Oven Heat Source, Oven Heat Distribution and Oven Baking Space blocks. A basic build requires three copper plates and chosen stone in its component recipes.

vanillaDelta.text: Expands baking capacity using a heat-distribution network, rather than a stacked firebox/meat-grill/chimney assembly. Native guide compares larger baking jobs with the clay oven.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified. Native assets define construction and component variants.

crossModInteractions.text: Native guide reports support for items baked in the vanilla clay oven. That is a broad author claim, not individual live proof for Rustic Cookery pot roasts; its own directions still name clay ovens.

practicalHowTo.text: Place Heat Distribution to the left or right of Heat Source, then Baking Space in front of Heat Distribution. Put burnable material in Heat Source and light with a torch; place dough on Baking Space as in a clay oven. Additional distribution/baking blocks expand the build, with less heat farther away.

metadata.name: Tankards, Goblets and More!
metadata.description: Drink in style! Adds a variety of tankards, goblets and bottles into Vintage Story.

playerImpact.text: Adds tankards/goblets as liquid containers with display/storage behavior; wooden tankard capacity 1 L and transfer increment .5 L.

vanillaDelta.text: Functional serving vessels, not a new brewing mechanic.

configStatus.text: No dedicated exported config identified; the wooden vessel properties are native block attributes.

crossModInteractions.text: Wood tankard uses BlockLiquidContainerTopOpened, MilkingContainer, shelvable/displayable flags. Tea is containable liquid: asset-supported pairing, not live-client transfer proof.

practicalHowTo.text: Craft stick/plank over empty/plank in a 2 by 2 grid, then use the wooden tankard for liquids. Open other vessel recipes rather than assuming identical material costs.

pages.title: Kitchen - First fire and first meal
pages.intro: Kindle separate tinder, then choose a quick roast or a cooking-pot meal.

steps.label: Build the firepit
steps.text: Gather four dry grass and four firewood; craft a firestarter from two diagonal sticks. Sneak-right-click one dry grass onto solid ground, then right-click it with four firewood. Save another dry grass for separate tinder and two for torches.

steps.label: Kindle separate tinder
steps.text: Sneak-right-click another dry grass onto the ground beside the completed firepit. Aim the firestarter at this separate tinder and sneak-right-click to begin. Keep sneaking, stay still, and alternate left/right clicks until you hold glowing tinder.

steps.label: Light the pit
steps.text: Carry the glowing tinder to the completed firepit and right-click it. If ignition is refused, check the environmental warning: Firestarters also imposes weather restrictions on ignition tools.

steps.label: Roast on a stick
steps.text: Put roastable raw food in your offhand and a normal stick in your main hand; right-click to skewer it. Hold right-click with the loaded stick aimed at a burning firepit to roast. Empty your offhand and Ctrl-right-click to remove the food.

steps.label: Upgrade to pot meals
steps.text: Clay-form and pit-fire a pot and bowl. Put the fired pot in the firepit, fill its ingredient slots with a valid meal recipe and matching portion counts, then cook. Right-click the cooked pot with an empty bowl to serve.

steps.label: Wash out leftovers
steps.text: To empty a held meal bowl or cooked container, aim at water and hold right-click for about one second. Washing empties its contents, so finish edible food first. This is an added held interaction, not a requirement to wash every already-empty dish.

pages.title: Kitchen - Knead dough and build a stone oven
pages.intro: Make dough by hand, cure better fuel, then bake in a larger oven.

steps.label: Knead dough
steps.text: Hold flour, aim at water, and keep right-click held for about one second to make matching-grain dough. Start with spelt flour for spelt dough. Looking at water avoids needing a portable water container. This pack enables removal of the dough grid recipes targeted by Manual Dough.

steps.label: Cure better fuel
steps.text: Shapelessly combine a knife and 2 ordinary firewood for 2 prepared firewood, then let it cure into seasoned fuel; the base curing transition is 96 in-game hours. Alternatively surround resin or beeswax with 8 firewood to craft 8 seasoned firewood directly. The exported pack disables further curing into aged firewood; raw firewood remains allowed for first-fire construction and clay ovens.

steps.label: Connect the three oven components
steps.text: Craft one Oven Heat Source, one Oven Heat Distribution and one Oven Baking Space using the linked component recipes. The native guide lists three copper plates and your chosen stone for the basic set. Place Heat Distribution to the left or right of Heat Source, then place Baking Space in front of Heat Distribution. These are adjacent functional blocks, not a vertical grill-and-chimney stack.

steps.label: Fuel and bake
steps.text: Put burnable fuel into Oven Heat Source and light it with a torch. Place dough on Oven Baking Space just as you would in a clay oven, then wait for it to bake. Add more distribution and baking spaces for larger batches, but remember that heat falls with distance from the source.

steps.label: Try an oven pot roast
steps.text: Rustic Cookery is a separate branch: with tongs in your offhand, work a roasting dish on a lit firepit. Render fat, sear a whole meat slab, add sides and braising liquid, then remove the roast and finish it in a preheated clay oven. Place the baked roast and right-click with an empty bowl to serve.

pages.title: Kitchen - Tea, drinkware and cold storage
pages.intro: Brew a known-safe flower, use a reusable tankard, and store food in purpose-built containers.

steps.label: Brew safe floral tea
steps.text: Use a cooking pot on a lit firepit. For one floral-tea portion, use 1 L water and one cornflower; wild daisy and golden poppy are other listed floral ingredients. Cook to obtain hot floral tea. Do not substitute arbitrary flowers: lily of the valley and the listed lupines produce toxic tea.

steps.label: Craft a tankard
steps.text: Use a 2 by 2 grid: stick/plank in the first row, empty/plank in the second. The wooden tankard is a liquid container for tea; it holds 1 L and transfers 0.5 L at a time. Metal tankards and goblets are alternatives, not prerequisites.

steps.label: Use hot or cold tea
steps.text: Drink tea hot when practical: the liquid asset gives hot tea a base four-hour freshness period before its cold variant. Cold tea eventually decays back to water. Medicinal tea has a separate ingredient list; toxic tea damages health, so keep it apart from safe drinks.

steps.label: Chill food correctly
steps.text: Select shelves and baskets by their accepted contents, not their appearance. Keep the Cooling Cabinet doors closed. Add Cut Ice to its dedicated drawer and close that too: the extra cooling needs both compartments closed. Replace melting ice regularly.

steps.label: Maintain an ice reserve
steps.text: Store spare Cut Ice in an Ice Keeper to prevent melting. For baskets inside a cabinet, right-click with accepted food to insert it; Ctrl inserts multiple, while Ctrl with an empty hand removes one item. Read the block tooltip for its actual freshness, curing or drying effect rather than assuming every shelf refrigerates.
